en: The image shows an old postcard with two main colorized photographs. The left photograph depicts an elaborate interior with vaulted ceilings, wood paneling, and a large model ship hanging from the ceiling—this is labeled 'Artushof.' The right photograph shows a grand building with arched windows, gabled roofs, and people in horse-drawn carriages in front—this is labeled 'Börse.' The postcard has printed text in German at the bottom and along the side.
